name: Apopalypse
notes: Randomly generated rounds (500+ bloon groups) with NO break between rounds: the next round spawns once the previous one finishes spawning. Ground objects (spikes) persist. Leads from R20, Camo from R19, Ceramics from R33, MOABs from R41, BFBs 51, ZOMGs 61, DDTs 81. End-of-round cash exists (added in a later update). Events/odyssey use fixed seeds. Leaving and re-entering lowers difficulty. Win round DISPUTED: bloonswiki's (undated, unversioned) update-history line says "Completing round 70 now counts as beating the mode"; the fandom Apopalypse (BTD6) article says victory is "popping all bloons spawned from Round 1 to Round 60", and a 2022 guide says 60 rounds. Unresolved 2026-11-05.
inferred: endRound 70 from bloonswiki version-history line (undated); fandom article and a 2022 guide say 60 - UNRESOLVED, see endRoundAlt
